title: Green Regulation, Trade Friendliness, and Local Policy Adaptation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of national policies on local policy formulation by studying the interplay between a top-down environmental regulation and the local Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) policies. We compiled a database of prefecture-level FDI policies in China spanning four decades and leveraged the Two Control Zones (TCZ) policy that designated some prefectures for pollution abatement. A diﬀerence-in-diﬀerences analysis shows that the TCZ designated cities formulated more friendly FDI policies after the TCZ policy. Mechanism analyses suggest that local governments loosen FDI regulations to offset economic costs of environmental regulation and attain political promotion.
abstract_zh: 本文通过研究自上而下的环境监管与地方外商直接投资（FDI）政策之间的相互作用，考察了国家政策对地方政策制定的影响。我们汇编了中国四十年间地级市层面的FDI政策数据库，并利用划定部分城市进行污染治理的两控区（TCZ）政策。双重差分分析表明，被划入TCZ的城市在该政策实施后制定了更为友好的FDI政策。机制分析表明，地方政府放松外资监管，以抵消环境监管带来的经济成本，并获得政治晋升。

Adulterated Spice: Lead Poisoning, Conflicts, and Fertility

Symptom or Culprit? Social Media, Air Pollution, and Violence
abstract: This paper provides the first causal evidence that hostile activities online lead to physical violence. Given the recently documented relationship between pollution and social media, I exploit exogenous variation in local air quality as the first step to instrument for online aggression. In an event study setting, I find volatile organic compounds (VOCs) increase by 7% when refineries experience unexpected production outages. Together with higher air pollution, I find more aggressive behaviors both online and offline, as well as worse health outcomes near refineries. A one standard deviation increase in surrounding VOCs leads to 0.16 more hate crimes against Black people and 0.23 more hospital visits per thousand people each day. Second, I consider how emotional contagion spreads through social networks. On days with pollution spikes, surrounding areas see 30% more offensive and racist tweets and 12% more crimes; those geographically distant but socially networked regions also see offensive and racist tweets increase by 3% and more crimes by 4.5%. Nationally, overlooking spillovers would underestimate crime effects of pollution by 24%. My findings highlight the consequences of social media hostility and contribute to the public debate on cyberspace regulation.
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了网络敌对行为导致身体暴力的因果证据。鉴于此前已记录的污染与社交媒体之间的关系，我利用当地空气质量的外生变化，作为网络攻击的第一步工具变量。在事件研究框架中，我发现，炼油厂出现意外的生产中断时，挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）增加7%。伴随着空气污染的增加，我发现线上和线下的攻击性行为都有所增加，炼油厂附近的健康状况也更差。周边VOCs每增加一个标准差，每天会导致针对黑人的仇恨犯罪增加0.16起，每千人的医院就诊次数增加0.23次。其次，我考察了情绪传染如何通过社交网络扩散。在污染飙升的日子里，周边地区的攻击性和种族主义推文增加了30%，犯罪增加了12%；在地理上较远但存在社交网络联系的地区，攻击性和种族主义推文也增加了3%，犯罪增加了4.5%。在全国范围内，忽略溢出效应会使污染的犯罪效应被低估24%。我的发现突出了社交媒体敌意的后果，并为有关网络空间监管的公共讨论做出了贡献。

title: When Growth Stumbles, Pollute? Trade War, Environmental Enforcement, and Pollution
When the State Cannot Enforce: International Monitoring and Tropical Deforestation
abstract: Many protected areas in low-capacity countries are poorly enforced. Can external monitoring without enforcement power substitute for missing state capacity? UNESCO World Heritage inscription adds an international monitoring layer on top of existing domestic protection without changing legal status, providing within-site variation in monitoring intensity. Using staggered inscription across 276 sites and two complementary satellite outcomes over 2001-2024, I find that inside-boundary vegetation cover rises 0.030 units after inscription, 9% relative to the average index. Annual tropical forest loss falls 0.099 percentage points, equivalent to 200 hectares saved per median site and $9.4 million in annual climate benefits. Effects concentrate where domestic enforcement is weakest and where international monitoring is most active. External monitoring substitutes for weak enforcement when sustained.
abstract_zh: 许多低能力国家的保护区执法不力。在缺乏执法权力的情况下，外部监测能否替代国家能力的缺失？联合国教科文组织世界遗产列入名录在不改变法律地位的前提下，于既有国内保护之上增加了一层国际监测，从而在遗址内部形成监测强度的差异。利用2001–2024年间276个遗址的交错列入数据以及两个互补的卫星观测结果，我发现：列入后，边界内植被覆盖指数上升0.030个单位，相对于平均指数提高9%。热带森林年损失下降0.099个百分点，相当于每个中位遗址每年保住200公顷森林，并带来每年940万美元的气候效益。效应集中出现在国内执法最薄弱、国际监测最活跃的地区。只要国际监测得以持续，外部监测就能替代薄弱的执法。

title: AI and the Deterrence-Erosion Multiplier in Crowdsourced Data
Airlines, Pollution, and Fertility
abstract: This paper demonstrates a large but little-known negative externality of the aviation industry. Using a new instrument for air pollution from aircraft cruising, we show that pollution is higher beneath overhead flight routes in ways uncorrelated with local pollution. We combine this cross-sectional variation with the launch of new flight routes to establish several findings. First, aircraft cruising persistently elevates local PM2.5 by 1-3 μg/m3. Second, PM2.5 has adverse impacts on infant health via lower birth weights, including in 44 developing countries where data are scarce. Third, we leverage the fact that propeller planes still use leaded fuel to show that 1 ng/m3 ambient lead reduces fertility rates by 0.19%. Fourth, we generalize this in relation to the historical phase-out of leaded fuel in vehicles, which our analysis suggests added over 2 million people per year to the global population---making it among the most material public health interventions. We provide this global gridded airline data product for use in future research.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了航空业一项规模巨大却鲜为人知的负外部性。利用飞机巡航所产生空气污染的一个新工具变量，我们发现航线正下方的污染水平更高，且这种差异与当地污染状况无关。我们将这一横截面变异与新航线开通相结合，得出以下几项发现。第一，飞机巡航会使当地PM2.5持续升高1–3 μg/m³。第二，PM2.5通过降低出生体重对婴儿健康产生不利影响，包括在数据稀缺的44个发展中国家。第三，我们利用螺旋桨飞机仍使用含铅燃油这一事实发现，环境空气铅浓度每增加1 ng/m³，生育率下降0.19%。第四，我们将结论推广至汽车含铅汽油的历史性淘汰过程，分析表明该过程每年使全球人口增加200多万人，堪称影响最为重大的公共健康干预措施之一。我们提供了这一全球网格化航空数据产品，供未来研究使用。

title: Bioenergy Policy and Cross-Border Deforestation
abstract: Domestic green policies can shift environmental costs abroad through international supply chains. I study biomass-fired electricity that burns wood pellets as fuel. Combining data on power plants, satellite pollution and land use, and trade, I find that biomass plant expansion raises the retirement probability of nearby coal plants by 3 percentage points and lowers SO₂ pollution by 2.3 percent. Exploiting biomass promotion policies in Japan and South Korea, I trace induced wood demand to Southeast Asia, where it causes 18,000 km² of forest loss over eight years. The carbon release requires over a decade of coal displacement to offset.
abstract_zh: 国内绿色政策可能通过国际供应链将环境成本转移至境外。本文研究以木屑颗粒为燃料的生物质发电。结合发电厂、卫星污染监测、土地利用和贸易数据，我发现生物质电厂扩张使附近燃煤电厂的退役概率提高3个百分点，并使SO₂污染降低2.3%。利用日本和韩国的生物质促进政策，我追踪到由此引发的木材需求流向东南亚，在那里导致了8年间18,000平方公里的森林损失。碳排放需要超过十年的燃煤发电替代才能抵消。

Rapid Increases in Methane Concentrations Following August 2020 Suspension of the US Methane Rule
venue: NBER Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In August 2020, the Trump administration removed Obama-era federal requirements that oil and gas firms detect and repair methane leaks. We merge geographic information system coordinates of 1,193,575 wells, 478 natural gas processing facilities, and 1,367 compressor stations to geo-identified methane concentrations from the European TROPOspheric Monitoring Instrument (TROPOMI, satellite instrument). Using a difference-in-differences design, we find a large, prompt increase in US methane emissions at oil and gas infrastructure sites following the August 2020 rollback relative to areas without such infrastructure. Average methane concentrations increased by 5 parts per billion (ppb), or one-quarter of a standard deviation. The number of high methane emission events from the oil and gas sector more than doubled relative to the coal sector, which did not experience the rollback. Gas producers and distributors have argued they face an overriding incentive to minimize fugitive methane emissions and venting without regulation—so as to recover and sell a valuable commercial product. The large and nimble response to federal policy we find—together with basic microeconomic theory—indicates otherwise and provides empirical support for policy’s central role in curbing global methane concentrations.
abstract_zh: 2020年8月，特朗普政府取消了奥巴马时期对油气企业的联邦要求，即这些企业须检测并修复甲烷泄漏。我们将1,193,575口油井、478座天然气处理设施和1,367座压缩机站的地理信息系统坐标，与欧洲对流层监测仪（TROPOMI，卫星仪器）提供的地理定位甲烷浓度数据相匹配。利用双重差分设计，我们发现，相较于不存在此类基础设施的地区，在2020年8月放松管制之后，油气基础设施所在地的美国甲烷排放立即出现大幅增长。平均甲烷浓度上升了5个十亿分率（ppb），相当于四分之一个标准差。油气行业的高甲烷排放事件数量相对于未经历放松管制的煤炭行业增加了一倍多。天然气生产商和分销商曾主张，他们面临压倒性的动机，即在没有监管的情况下尽量减少逸散性甲烷排放和放空，以回收并出售这种有价值的商品。我们发现的对联邦政策的大幅而迅速的反应，加之基本的微观经济理论，表明情况并非如此，并为政策在遏制全球甲烷浓度方面的核心作用提供了实证支持。

title: Competing with Clean Air: Pollution Disclosure and College Desirability
abstract: Starting in 2013, China's pollution information disclosure program raised public awareness of air quality. This study seeks to analyze the impact of information disclosure on college desirability. To that end, I assemble a comprehensive dataset on admission scores for all colleges in China for eight years. In an event study setting, I find pollution information drives down cutoff scores for colleges in dirty cities by 0.3% for the arts track and 0.6% for the science track, equivalent to 20 thousand and 30 thousand high school graduates per year. While first- and second-tier colleges see large and robust effects, third-tier colleges are not affected by this amenity information shock. The effect is mainly driven by the increased competition for clean colleges, and is more prominent for journalism, economics and environment-related majors. My findings confirm the importance of environmental information and are consistent with people's avoidance behavior against pollution.
abstract_zh: 自2013年起，中国的污染信息披露计划提高了公众的空气质量意识。本研究旨在分析信息披露对高校吸引力的影响。为此，我整理了八年间中国所有高校录取分数线的综合数据。在事件研究框架下，我发现污染信息使污染严重城市高校的录取分数线下降：文科批次下降0.3%，理科批次下降0.6%，分别相当于每年约2万和3万名高中毕业生。一、二线高校受到的影响显著且稳健，而三线高校并未受到这一环境信息冲击的影响。该效应主要由清洁城市高校之间的竞争加剧所驱动，并且在新闻学、经济学以及环境相关专业中更为突出。我的研究结果证实了环境信息的重要性，并与人们规避污染的行为相一致。

Lessons Learned from China's Regional Carbon Market Pilots
abstract: This paper gives an overview of the performance of China's seven regional carbon market pilots and the range of approaches they have used. We assessed the outcomes of these pilots using publicly available secondary market trading data. The differences in market performance are explained by the design of key market elements such as emission allowances, covered sectors, allowance allocation, monitoring, reporting and verification, compliance and penalties, and offset market. The lessons learned from the regional carbon market pilots are used to provide insights that can aid in the design of the upcoming national carbon market.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了中国七个区域碳市场试点的运行表现以及其所采用的各种方法。我们利用公开可得的二级市场交易数据评估了这些试点的成效。市场表现的差异可以通过关键市场要素的设计来解释，包括排放配额、覆盖行业、配额分配、监测、报告与核查、履约与处罚以及抵消市场。区域碳市场试点的经验教训，可为即将建立的全国碳市场的设计提供启示。
